## Cairo Heat-Safety Snapshot for July 10–12, 2026
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/thermometer-half.svg

Cairo will be in **dangerously hot, high-UV conditions** for all 3 days. The safest plan is to keep walking to early morning or after sunset, increase fluids steadily, and reduce outdoor exposure during peak heat.

## 3-Day Heat-Safety Plan
| Date | Forecast | Hydration target | Best walking hours | Heat-risk note |
|---|---|---:|---|---|
| 2026-07-10 | 41°C / 29°C, 18% humidity, UV 11, very hot and sunny | **3.0–3.5 L/day** | **Before 8:00 AM** or **after 7:30 PM** | Avoid midday outdoor time; shade is still not enough at peak sun |
| 2026-07-11 | 43°C / 30°C, 15% humidity, UV 11, extreme heat | **3.5–4.0 L/day** | **Before 7:30 AM** or **after 8:00 PM** | Highest-risk day; limit walking to short essential trips only |
| 2026-07-12 | 39°C / 28°C, 22% humidity, UV 10, hot and dry | **3.0–3.5 L/day** | **Before 8:00 AM** or **after 7:00 PM** | Still unsafe in direct sun at midday, but slightly better than July 11 |

### Daily heat-safety actions
- **July 10:** Start hydrating early, then keep outdoor time short. Use shaded routes and plan indoor breaks every 30–45 minutes.
- **July 11:** Treat as the strictest rest day. If you must go out, do it very early, stay near air conditioning, and avoid long walks.
- **July 12:** Resume only light walking in cooler hours. Keep sun exposure low even if the temperature is slightly lower.

### Older-adult checklist
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/house.svg
- Drink water regularly, even without thirst.
- Carry a water bottle and sip every 15–20 minutes outdoors.
- Wear a wide-brim hat, light loose clothing, and sunglasses.
- Use broad-spectrum sunscreen and reapply if outside.
- Avoid walking alone in peak heat if possible.
- Take rest breaks in air-conditioned places.
- Watch for dizziness, headache, confusion, nausea, or unusual fatigue.
- If any heat-illness signs appear, move to cool shade, hydrate, and seek help quickly.

## Best Walking Window by Day
- **July 10:** 6:00–8:00 AM, 7:30–9:00 PM
- **July 11:** 5:45–7:30 AM, 8:00–9:30 PM
- **July 12:** 6:00–8:00 AM, 7:00–9:00 PM
